# Apple Hospitality REIT Announces Dates for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


09/14/2026


Download a pdf version PDF Format (opens in new window)


RICHMOND, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. (NYSE: APLE) (the “Company” or “Apple Hospitality”) today announced that it plans to report third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Thursday, November 5, 2026, and host a conference call for investors and interested parties at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Friday, November 6, 2026, to discuss the results.


The conference call will be accessible by telephone and the internet. To access the call, participants from within the U.S. should dial 877-407-9039, and participants from outside the U.S. should dial 201-689-8470. Participants may also access the call via live webcast by visiting the Investor Information section of the Company’s website at[ir.applehospitalityreit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.applehospitalityreit.com%2FCorporateProfile%2F&esheet=54603677&newsitemid=20260914760270&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.applehospitalityreit.com&index=1&md5=8c9f67b4dcdd2f58e179f1717be8fec1) .


A replay of the call will be available from approximately 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 6, 2026, through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 20, 2026. To access the replay, the domestic dial-in number is 844-512-2921, the international dial-in number is 412-317-6671, and the passcode is 13762627. In addition, an archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website for a limited time.


**About Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc.** Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. (NYSE: APLE) is a publicly traded real estate investment trust (“REIT”) that owns one of the largest and most diverse portfolios of upscale, rooms-focused hotels in the United States. Apple Hospitality’s portfolio consists of 216 hotels with approximately 29,500 guest rooms located in 83 markets throughout 37 states and the District of Columbia. Concentrated with industry-leading brands, the Company’s hotel portfolio consists of 114 Hilton-branded hotels, 96 Marriott-branded hotels, five Hyatt-branded hotels and one independent hotel. For more information, please visit[www.applehospitalityreit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.applehospitalityreit.com&esheet=54603677&newsitemid=20260914760270&lan=en-US&anchor=www.applehospitalityreit.com&index=2&md5=70309381e80f08cc4429fd5cfde5ed7a) .
